system_metadata.project: Automated Regulatory Compliance Verification System for Packaged Commodities
governing_statutes: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Act No. 1 of 2010)
The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended up to 2026)
The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Act No. 34 of 2006)
Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011
Food Safety and Standards (Contaminants, Toxins and Residues) Regulations, 2011
Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018
Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations, 2011
Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Directives

amendments_2025.subject: Medical Devices Harmonization
amendments_2025.description: Aligns PCR with Medical Devices Rules, 2017. Labelling dimensions and font sizes under MDR 2017 take precedence. Declarations exempted from front PDP if compliant with MDR outer pack rules.

amendments_2025.notification: PCR Second Amendment Rules, 2025 (December 2025, effective Feb 1, 2026)
amendments_2025.subject: Pan Masala Small Pack Exemption Removal
amendments_2025.description: Removes 10g/10cm3 exemption. Mandatory Retail Sale Price (RSP), Net Qty, and all statutory declarations on all pan masala packs regardless of weight.

amendments_2026.subject: E-Commerce Searchable Country of Origin Filter
amendments_2026.description: Mandates digital e-commerce marketplaces to provide a searchable and sortable filter based on Country of Origin for all imported products.

amendments_2026.subject: Importer Declarations at AEO Bonded Warehouses
amendments_2026.description: Permits AEO Tier-2 and Tier-3 certified importers to affix mandatory declarations at customs bonded warehouses before goods exit the bonded perimeter.

amendments_2026.subject: Decriminalization & Administrative Compounding
amendments_2026.description: Transitions minor first-time metrology infractions to civil adjudication officers under structured administrative compounding schedules.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Food Adulteration
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Sec 3(1)(a), Sec 26, Sec 51)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Addition of cheaper, inferior, or toxic foreign substances or abstraction of nutritive constituents.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹5,00,000 (sub-standard) to life imprisonment + ₹10,00,000 (injurious/toxic adulteration).

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Unsafe Food
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Sec 3(1)(zx), Sec 59)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Food injurious to health due to micro-pathogens, toxins, chemical residues, or decomposition.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Imprisonment from 6 months to life imprisonment + fine up to ₹10,00,000; immediate batch recall.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Spoiled Food
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Sec 26(2)(i), Sec 59)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Natural decomposition, putrefaction, rancidity, or microbial fermentation rendering food unfit.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 to ₹3,00,000; lot confiscation.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Contamination
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: FSS (Contaminants, Toxins and Residues) Regulations, 2011; FSSA 2006 Sec 21
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Extraneous heavy metals, pesticides exceeding MRLs, veterinary drug residues, or radiological matter.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 (extraneous matter) to ₹5,00,000 (chemical exceedance).

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Hygiene Problem
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Sec 56 read with Schedule 4)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Unsanitary processing, storage, or distribution conditions posing contamination hazards.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Penalty up to ₹1,00,000 + suspension of FSSAI operating license.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Misleading Label
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: FSS (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018; LMPC Rule 13; FSSA Sec 24 & 53
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Deceptive descriptions, unauthorized claims ('Natural', 'Fresh', 'Pure', '100% Fruit Juice' on reconstituted juice, 'ORS' on synthetic drinks).
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹10,00,000 (FSSA Sec 53); CCPA misleading advertisement actions.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Missing Label Declaration
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: LMPC Rules, 2011 (Rule 6); FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 (Reg 5)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Omission of any mandatory statutory declarations (Manufacturer, Origin, Common Name, Net Qty, MRP, USP, Date, Consumer Care).
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹25,000 (first) to ₹1,00,000 or 1 yr jail (subsequent) under LM Act Sec 36(2); Misbranding fine up to ₹3,00,000.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Wrong Net Quantity
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: LMPC Rules, 2011 (Rules 11, 12, 13 & First Schedule MPE); LM Act Sec 36(1)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Use of illegal metric symbols (gms, kgs, ltrs), vague expressions (approx), or measured quantity short of declaration beyond MPE.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹25,000 to ₹1,00,000 or 1 yr imprisonment under LM Act Sec 36(1).

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: MRP Issue
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Overcharging above MRP, missing '(incl. of all taxes)', price overlay stickers over original MRP, or dual MRP in multiplexes/airports.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 per violation; seizure of lot under Section 15.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Expiry Date Issue
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 (Reg 5(6)); FSSA Sec 26(2)(iv)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Selling or stocking products beyond declared Expiry / Use By Date, separated dates, or tampered date stamps.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Treated as unsafe/substandard food: Fine up to ₹3,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 + stock destruction.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Packaging Issue
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: FSS (Packaging) Regulations, 2018 (OML limits, printing ink IS 15495, newspaper ban)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Use of newspaper wrapping, uncertified recycled plastics, printing ink touching food, or compromised package seal.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Penalty up to ₹2,00,000 under FSSA Sec 58; cancellation of registration.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Ingredient Disclosure
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Missing ingredient list in descending order, compound ingredient disclosure omissions, or missing INS numbers for additives.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹3,00,000 for misbranding under FSSA Sec 52.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Allergen Declaration
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Failure to declare 8 major food allergens (gluten, crustacean, egg, fish, peanut, soy, milk, sulphite) in bold or callout box.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹3,00,000 for misbranding under FSSA Sec 52; mandatory product recall if dangerous.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: FSSAI Information
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Missing or illegible FSSAI logo and 14-digit license number, checksum failures, or inactive/expired FoSCoS status.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Fine up to ₹3,00,000 under FSSA Sec 52; criminal forgery charges for fraudulent numbers.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Unlicensed Food Business
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Sec 31 & Sec 63)
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Operating a food business, packing, or selling pre-packaged food without a valid active FSSAI License or Registration.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Imprisonment up to 6 months AND fine up to ₹5,00,000 under FSSA Sec 63; premises sealing.

violation_ontology_16_categories.title: Other Food Safety
violation_ontology_16_categories.statute: State Gazettes (FSSA Sec 30(2)(a)); Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
violation_ontology_16_categories.description: Maharashtra Section 30(2)(a) Gutkha/scented supari ban, loose edible oil sale ban (Reg 2.3.15), or e-commerce dark patterns.
violation_ontology_16_categories.penalty: Immediate criminal seizure under Sec 30/59; penalties under Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
